SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_desc, p.product_image, p.product_category, p.hanwoo_yn, p.origin_cd, p.use_yn, pp.price_id, pp.base_date, pp.price_per_kg, ps.stock_id, ps.weight_per_box, ps.box_qty, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM product p
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT price_id, base_date, price_per_kg FROM product_price WHERE product_id = p.product_id AND use_yn = 'Y' AND base_date <= #{baseDate} ORDER BY base_date DESC, price_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pp ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT stock_id, weight_per_box, box_qty FROM product_stock WHERE product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY stock_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ps ON TRUE WHERE p.use_yn = 'Y'
AND p.hanwoo_yn = 'Y'
AND p.origin_cd = 'KR'
AND p.origin_cd IN ('US', 'AU')
AND p.origin_cd = 'US'
AND p.origin_cd = 'AU'
AND p.origin_cd = 'AU' AND p.product_name LIKE '%와규%'
ORDER BY p.product_id ASC

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT price_id, base_date, price_per_kg FROM product_price WHERE product_id = p.product_id AND use_yn = 'Y' AND base_date <= #{baseDate} ORDER BY base_date DESC, price_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pp ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT stock_id, weight_per_box, box_qty FROM product_stock WHERE product_id = p.product_id ORDER BY stock_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ps ON TRUE WHERE p.product_id = #{productId} AND p.use_yn = 'Y'
